How to Publish on GitHub Pages

Send her the live link in under 2 minutes!

1

Save as index.html

This file is 100% self-contained with all images embedded! Rename it to index.html.

2

Create a Free GitHub Repo

Go to github.com/new and name it e.g. birthday-sister. Set to Public.

3

Upload the file

Click "Upload an existing file" and drag index.html into GitHub, then click Commit changes.

4

Turn on GitHub Pages

In repo Settings ➔ Pages (on left sidebar) ➔ under "Branch", choose main ➔ click Save!

5

Your Live Link is Ready!

In ~60 seconds your link will be live at:
https://yourusername.github.io/birthday-sister/. Text it to her!
